normalize.note: flex = (raw - open) / (fist - open), |fist-open|<1 -> 1; acc = raw / 8192; gyro = (raw - gyro_bias_raw) / 65.5 / 250. Tolerance 1e-4.

model.note: each model: input float32 [1,100,11] = normalized window, oldest sample first; output 22 probabilities in labels order. probs_each = each model in decider.json 'models' order; probs = their average (what the Decider gets). Tolerance 1e-3.

decider.note: feed these probability vectors one by one (one per model run, every 10 samples) into the Decider with this config; it must emit exactly these events at these steps.

gaps.note: feed 'input' one sample at a time: [seq, f0..f4, ax, ay, az, gx, gy, gz]. seq is uint16 and wraps 65535 -> 0. Gap rule (AI-SPEC section 4): 1-5 missing samples -> repeat the last good sample that many times (they count as samples); more than 5 -> clear the window, restart the sample counter, reset the Decider, and emit cancel for a pending tentative word first; a duplicate or older seq ((seq - expected) mod 65536 >= 32768) is dropped and not counted, but more than 10 dropped in a row means the glove restarted: treat it as a gap of more than 5. The USB/CSV seq is uint8 (wraps 255 -> 0): use mod 256 (drop when >= 128) until a seq above 255 is seen. 'expected' = every event, with the 0-based index of the input sample that produced it. The file has a 3-sample gap, a duplicate, an older seq, a wrap, and a 12-sample gap right after a tentative word.
